title: Singing in choirs and quartets
summary: He sang in choirs and quartets and broadcast over WSMB.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: I wanted to play music. I just wanted to play music. When did you start singing? I've been singing since I was a boy in school.
Did you sing in choirs or anything?
I sang in choirs, quartets, everything. I used to broadcast over WSMB, with the Harmonized and Brown quartet. When the South Side's anything quartet, you used to sing against them.
I was a band. Well you really were a singer before you were a piano player, huh? I was a bandjole player.
I played the bandjole. Well I know you played the bass fiddle too. Yeah.
